name: 01890 · Winchester, MA
findings: ZIP 01890 (Winchester) has 143 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01890 (Winchester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01890 (Winchester) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.
